messages:
Alex: quick q — where do folks keep the saved searches for slicing logs by org / model / route / region / status? trying to build a small dashboard for the canary rollout
Marta: we keep canonical presets in Logs -> Saved Views. you can also browse the shared folder `ops/queries`. direct link: https://console.redwood/logs/saved-views :link:
Alex: awesome, any example snippets? i need org=acme, route=/v1/generate, p95 5xx and kv-cache miss counts as separate panels
Sam: try this as a starting point:
```
org:acme AND route:"/v1/generate" | stats count() as total_requests, count_if(status >= 500) as errors by region | metric p95(latency_ms)
```
Sam: for kv cache misses we tag events with `kv_miss:true` so:
```
org:acme AND route:"/v1/generate" AND kv_miss:true | stats count() by model_name, region
```
Marta: note we also have a preset called `route-model-presets` that exposes fields: org, model_name, route, region, status_class. save names should be short and reusable — i usually prefix with the org, e.g. `acme/gen/routes/5xx`
Alex: perfect. can someone save + pin a canonical one for the eng-sre dashboard? i want infra and product to reuse it for alerts
Kai: for alerting on 5xx spike: drop eval window to 5m for canary, use 3-sigma above baseline p95 error rate OR absolute > 0.5% depending on traffic. alert rule id is `/alerts/5421` if you want to test. also add an annotation linking the saved search
Alex: thanks. can we also include a snippet that filters by model variant? product wants to compare zenith-lite vs zenith-xl
Sam: yep — model lives under metadata.model_name in logs, e.g.:
```
org:acme AND metadata.model_name:"zenith-lite" AND route:"/v1/generate" | stats count(), count_if(status >= 500) by region
```
Marta: done — i created and pinned `ops/acme-gen-5xx-route` and added it to the eng-sre saved views. link: https://console.redwood/logs/saved-views/ops/acme-gen-5xx-route :pushpin:
ops-bot: Saved search created: ops/acme-gen-5xx-route by Marta at 2024-11-28T14:57:20Z
Alex: perfect, i'll add the dashboard panels and share with product. thanks all :thumbsup:
Kai: if you want help tuning thresholds for low-traffic regions ping me and i'll run a traffic-normalized baseline check
Alex: will do — tagging this resolved for now, reopening if anomalies crop up
